before.source:
Your connection to fire nourishes you. Whenever you strike an enemy in melee, you inflict a burning curse upon them. As long as they continue to burn, you gain %0.2f health and %0.2f vim per turn.
		Each turn they remain within 10 spaces of you, all enemies with cursed flames will spread it to other burning enemies in radius 1, causing you to heal for the same amount for each enemy, as well as dealing %d fire damage on spreading.
before.target:
恶魔之炎抚育你成长。每次你近战攻击命中时，你对目标施加诅咒，只要其处于燃烧状态，你每回合获得 %0.2f 生命与 %0.2f 活力。 
	同时，在你周围 10 码范围内，所有被诅咒火焰燃烧的敌方生物会将诅咒传播至半径 1 内的燃烧生物上，并造成 %d 火焰伤害同时给予你等量治疗。

after.source:
Your connection to fire nourishes you. Whenever you strike an enemy in melee, you inflict a burning curse upon them. As long as they continue to burn, you gain %0.2f health and %0.2f vim per turn.
		Each turn they remain within 10 spaces of you, all enemies with cursed flames will spread it to other burning enemies in radius 1, causing you to heal for the same amount for each enemy, as well as dealing %d fire damage on spreading.
after.target:
恶魔之火滋养着你。每当你的近战攻击命中敌人，便会对其施加诅咒之焰。每个受到诅咒之焰影响的敌人只要仍在燃烧，每回合都会为你恢复 %0.2f 点生命值并提供 %0.2f 点活力值。
	每回合，你半径 10 内每个受到诅咒之焰影响的敌人都有 50%% 几率，将诅咒传播给其半径 1 内尚未受诅咒的敌人，无论后者此前是否在燃烧。新受诅咒的敌人在持续燃烧期间，也会每回合为你恢复同等生命值并提供同等活力值。传播还会造成总计 %d 点火焰伤害，其中一半立即造成，另一半在接下来的 3 回合内造成。

source_provenance.ashes_source_status: The extraction snapshot identity is fixed, but the inspected public Ashes repository, commit, version and source revision are not fixed by the manifest. Its file hashes are frozen observed GPL-source anchors, not a pinned DLC revision.

flow: T_INFERNO_NEXUS.info formats the third placeholder from damDesc(..., t.getDam(self, t)).
A successful spread calls the already selected DamageType.FIREBURN projector directly with scalar t.getDam(self, t); the fourth argument DamageType.FIRE does not change the selected projector.
Scalar FIREBURN defaults to dur=3 and initial=50 percent.
FIREBURN immediately projects t.getDam * 0.5 as fire damage, then installs EFF_BURNING with power=(t.getDam * 0.5) / 3 for three timeouts.
EFF_BURNING.on_timeout projects eff.power as fire damage. Thus the displayed value is the nominal total of the complete default three-turn event.
damage_value_flow.decision: Render %d as total nominal FIREBURN damage, explicitly split between 50 percent immediate damage and the remaining 50 percent across the following three burn turns; it is not immediate-only damage, per-turn damage, or healing. Existing EFF_BURNING merge behavior can redistribute outstanding damage, so the rendering describes the nominal newly applied event rather than promising an unconditional observed tick schedule.

spread_behavior.timing: On each caster base turn, the outer radius-10 hostile projection considers every actor carrying EFF_CURSED_FLAMES.
spread_behavior.chance: Each cursed host independently rolls rng.percent(50) once for that base turn before projecting radius 1.
spread_behavior.host_filter: The host must be hostile, within radius 10 and currently carry EFF_CURSED_FLAMES.
spread_behavior.receiver_filter: The receiver must be hostile, within radius 1 of the successful host and not already carry EFF_CURSED_FLAMES; it does not need to be burning before receipt.
spread_behavior.receiver_deduplication: turn_procs.doombringer_burnt prevents multiple successful hosts from processing the same receiver during the same turn.
spread_behavior.player_facing_decision: State the independent 50%% chance, both radii, hostile/not-yet-cursed eligibility and absence of a pre-existing-burning prerequisite without exposing internal deduplication fields or callback names.

heal_vim_value_flow.melee_application: A successful melee hit applies EFF_CURSED_FLAMES with independent heal=t.getHeal and vim=t.getVim fields.
heal_vim_value_flow.spread_application: Each newly cursed receiver receives EFF_CURSED_FLAMES with the same independently computed heal and vim fields.
heal_vim_value_flow.timeout_behavior: Each cursed actor's effect timeout calls eff.src:heal(eff.heal) and eff.src:incVim(eff.vim), then removes the curse after the host no longer has a detrimental fire effect.
heal_vim_value_flow.decision: Each cursed enemy independently contributes the first two displayed values per turn while it keeps burning. These values do not come from t.getDam, are not equal to %d, and spreading grants no immediate heal.
